home.howItWorks.title: How Camel works
home.howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps to get a car hire company delivering to you — no airport desk, no queuing.
home.step1.title: Submit your request
home.step1.p1: Enter your pickup and drop-off location
home.step1.p2: Choose your dates, passengers and vehicle type
home.step1.p3: Your request is sent to local car hire companies
home.step2.title: Receive competitive bids
home.step2.p1: Local car hire companies within range are notified
home.step2.p2: Each company submits their best price for car hire and fuel
home.step2.p3: You see full price breakdowns — no hidden extras
home.step2.p4: Compare ratings and reviews from real customers
home.step3.title: Accept and confirm
home.step3.p1: Choose the offer that suits you best
home.step3.p2: The full fuel deposit is taken upon booking — refunded for what you don't use
home.step3.p3: Your driver meets you at the agreed location
home.step3.p4: Confirm fuel level and insurance, take the keys and go
home.fuel.title: You only pay for the fuel you use
home.fuel.subtitle: Your booking includes a full tank as a deposit. You pay only for the quarters used — the rest is refunded.
home.fuel.full.label: Returned full
home.fuel.three.label: Returned ¾ full
home.fuel.half.label: Returned half full
home.fuel.quarter.label: Returned ¼ full
home.noSurprises.title: No surprises when you arrive
home.noSurprises.body: Payment including fuel deposit is taken in full at the time of booking. When your driver arrives there is nothing left to do except confirm the fuel tank level, confirm you received your insurance documents, take the keys and go.
home.noSurprises.p1: Car delivered to your exact location — hotel, apartment, airport exit
home.noSurprises.p2: Full insurance with zero excess included in the price
home.noSurprises.p3: Full tank on delivery — pay only for the fuel you actually use
home.noSurprises.p4: All paperwork completed at booking — nothing to sign on arrival
home.noSurprises.p5: Reviews from real customers so you can choose with confidence
home.whyCamel.title: Why Book a Camel Car?
home.whyCamel.subtitle: How we compare to traditional car hire
home.traditional.label: Traditional car hire
home.traditional.p1: Queue at airport desk — often 30–60 minutes
home.traditional.p3: Fuel penalties if not returned full
home.traditional.p4: Hidden insurance charges and excess fees
home.camel.label: Camel Global
home.camel.p1: Car delivered directly to you — no queuing
home.camel.p2: Price fixed and confirmed at booking
home.camel.p3: Pay only for the fuel you actually use
home.camel.p4: Full insurance with zero excess, always included
